notes:
What's new in 0.9.241 (beta)
- Seconds on the PRO map: each turn badge on the PRO GOAT map shows the time gained or lost against the reference, in the corner colours; click a badge to pick that corner.
- Truer track maps: Assetto Corsa Monza and Dubai follow the real layout, the iRacing satellite view lines up better at Bathurst, Monza and Winton, and the map never draws an off-track moment as track.
- A clean PRO GOAT view per session: opening another session clears the PRO GOAT panels.
- One reference everywhere: GOAT Dash, SMART and the overlay use the same reference lap; an automatically picked reference gives way to your live best, a slow start lap is never the reference, and a lap is never compared with itself.
- Setup suggestions that fit the car: on Assetto Corsa, SMART only offers changes to settings in your saved setup and inside the car's range, and never says it changed a setup it did not change.
- AC pit limit: the pit-limit call always gives a number, measured for the car and track.
- Cleaner SMART radio: SMART no longer narrates about you; rival lines still come through.
- Telemetry files in use: a session file another program is still writing is retried quietly, then a plain message; the error banner clears after a good Retry.
- Lighter when you step away: the main window checks status less often while it is in the background, and a locked PC counts as away.

Known issue
- If you leave GOAT running in the tray for days, quit it from the tray icon and start it again once a day. Memory use grows slowly over time; a fix is coming.
